custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have three active parts: part A and part C in category A, and part B in category B, so the category A filter leaves part B out.
  • Give parts A, B and C part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists them, and descriptions that run A to Z in the order part A, part B, part C.
  • Make sure the test location has more than 30 active parts, so the list loads more rows as you scroll.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425597 PART A ALPHA; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425597-A; Category: category A; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
  2. Make part B: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425597 PART B BRAVO; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425597-B; Category: category B; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save.
  3. Make part C: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425597 PART C CHARLIE; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425597-C; Category: category A; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00. Click Save. (Pick the same category for A and C and another one for B.)
  4. The Active tab of Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 already lists more than 30 parts; scroll down to check that more rows load.
